name: mage vs mixed melee group
why: Kill weak melee groups with area spells while they bunch up, kite and finish stragglers, and retreat to recover mana or health before things turn dangerous.

open.says: Hit the nearest approaching monster with strong single-target spells (Energy Bolt/Flamestrike) from range, stepping back from melee. Loot only when nothing is close.

transitions.when: Three or more monsters are bunched up close to the mage and an area spell would hit them together.
Health is low, or the group is too strong or too many for the mage to handle and they are reaching it.
Mana is nearly gone and several monsters are still coming.

blast.says: Stand and cast area spells (Explosion or Chain Lightning) at the bunched-up monsters so each cast hurts them all.

transitions.when: Only one or two monsters are left close, or most are badly hurt.
transitions.unless: Three or more fairly healthy monsters are still bunched together.

transitions.when: Health is getting low with monsters still on the mage, or mana is nearly gone.
Mana is nearly gone and several monsters are still fighting.

finish.says: Kill the weakest monsters first with quick single-target spells, backing away from melee while casting.

transitions.when: Three or more monsters are bunched up close together again.
Health is low or mana is nearly gone while monsters are still fighting.
No monsters are close or coming at the mage.

escape.says: Run away from the monsters to get distance, then recover health and mana (potion if needed) before returning.

transitions.when: Nothing hostile is close and health and mana have recovered to a comfortable level.
